Description: Icon-only buttons must have accessible names
All form controls need labels or aria-label
Modal dialogs must trap focus inside
Do: Use focus trap library or manual focus management

Description: Design must work at all common breakpoints
Code Example Good: Tailwind: sm: md: lg: xl: breakpoints

Do: Cap content width at 65-80ch for text

Description: Buttons should show loading state when processing
Do: Disable button and show spinner during async operations
Use React ErrorBoundary with friendly fallback
Don't: Let errors crash the entire page

Do: Use font-display: swap to prevent invisible text

Description: Empty lists/pages need helpful empty states
Do: Show icon + message + action in empty state
Don't: Blank white space for empty data

Do: Show modal with description of what will be deleted
Code Example Good: <AlertDialog>Are you sure you want to delete...?</AlertDialog>
